announcements.title: End Semester Examination Schedule – July 2026
announcements.body: The End Semester Examinations for all UG and PG programs will commence from July 28, 2026. Students are requested to download their hall tickets from the student portal. Seating arrangements will be displayed on the notice boards of respective departments.

announcements.title: PES University Placement Drive – Microsoft
announcements.body: Microsoft will be conducting an on-campus recruitment drive on August 5, 2026 for B.Tech CSE, ECE, and MCA students. Eligible students must register on the placement portal by July 30. Pre-placement talk will be held on August 4 at 2:00 PM in Seminar Hall 1.

announcements.title: Library Extended Hours During Exam Period
announcements.body: The Central Library will remain open from 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM during the examination period (July 28 – August 15). Students are encouraged to utilize the reading rooms and digital resources available.

announcements.title: Workshop on AI and Machine Learning – Registration Open
announcements.body: The Department of Computer Science is organizing a 3-day workshop on 'Practical Applications of AI and Machine Learning' from August 10-12, 2026. Industry experts from Google and Amazon will conduct hands-on sessions. Registration is free for PES students.

announcements.title: Hostel Fee Payment Deadline – August 2026
announcements.body: Students residing in university hostels are reminded that the hostel fee for the next semester must be paid by August 1, 2026. Late payments will attract a penalty of ₹500 per day. Payment can be made through the student portal.

announcements.title: Inter-University Sports Meet 2026
announcements.body: PES University is hosting the Inter-University Sports Meet from August 20-25. Events include cricket, football, basketball, athletics, and swimming. Interested students can register with the Sports Department by August 10.

announcements.title: New Bus Routes Added – Whitefield & Electronic City
announcements.body: Two new bus routes have been added for the upcoming semester: Route 15 (Whitefield via ITPL) and Route 16 (Electronic City via Silk Board). Students can register for these routes through the transport portal starting August 1.

announcements.title: Research Paper Submission Deadline – ICSE Conference
announcements.body: Faculty and PhD scholars are informed that the deadline for submitting research papers to the International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE 2027) has been extended to September 15, 2026. Contact the Research Office for formatting guidelines.
